serviceCategories.description: This category provides information about services for individuals who have experienced abuse or trauma. Such as emotional, physical, or sexual abuse or traumatic events like accidents or disasters.
serviceCategories.name: Abuse & trauma

serviceCategories.description: This category provides information about services for individuals experiencing alcohol, drug, or other substance-related issues.
serviceCategories.name: Alcohol, drugs & addiction

serviceCategories.description: This category provides information about services for individuals with autism spectrum disorder (ASD), attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), and other neurodivergent conditions.
serviceCategories.name: Autism, ADHD & learning disabilities

serviceCategories.description: This category provides information about services for individuals experiencing grief, including specialised grief support for those who are bereaved by suicide.
serviceCategories.name: Bereavement

serviceCategories.description: This category provides information about services for individuals from specific cultural backgrounds and provides information about services that provide culturally sensitive support.
serviceCategories.name: Culturally specific

serviceCategories.description: This category provides information about services for individuals struggling with eating disorders, such as anorexia, bulimia, or binge eating disorder.
serviceCategories.name: Eating disorders

serviceCategories.description: This category provides information about services for individuals facing employment challenges, financial difficulties, and issues related to benefits, welfare support and the cost of living crisis.
serviceCategories.name: Employment, debt & benefits

serviceCategories.description: This category provides information about services for families and caregivers of people struggling with their mental health.
serviceCategories.name: Families & carers

serviceCategories.description: This category provides information about services for people who are experiencing housing-related challenges, including homelessness, eviction, or housing instability.
serviceCategories.name: Housing issues

serviceCategories.description: This category provides information about services specifically designed for the LGBTQIA+ community.
serviceCategories.name: LGBTQIA+

serviceCategories.description: This category provides information about services for older people, addressing their health, social, and emotional well-being.
serviceCategories.name: Older people

serviceCategories.description: This category provides information about services for individuals dealing with various physical health challenges and disabilities. Additionally, it includes resources related to sexual health.
serviceCategories.name: Physical health & disability

serviceCategories.description: This category provides information about services supporting individuals during pregnancy or parenting that focus on supporting individuals wellbeing and mental health.
serviceCategories.name: Pregnancy & parenting

serviceCategories.description: This category provides information about who to contact about complaints or problems with health care services.
serviceCategories.name: Problems with a service

serviceCategories.description: This category provides information about services that support individuals who have been displaced from their home countries and are seeking refuge or asylum.
serviceCategories.name: Refugees & asylum seekers

serviceCategories.description: This category provides information about services for individuals, couples or families experiencing challenges or seeking guidance in their relationships.
serviceCategories.name: Relationship support

serviceCategories.description: This category provides information about services for individuals dealing with a particular mental health condition, such as depression, anxiety, bipolar disorder, etc.
serviceCategories.name: Specific mental health condition

serviceCategories.description: This category provides information about services for military veterans and their families.
serviceCategories.name: Veterans
